# CANDIDATE: OPENING_GAP_VOLUME_IMBALANCE_REVERSAL

**Filed:** 2026-08-24
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A gap up on weak opening-bar volume often lacks follow-through and reverses, offering a short entry. The edge exists because weak volume on a gap up indicates lack of institutional conviction, making the move prone to reversal as initial enthusiasm fades.

## Mechanism

Entry rule: If the opening gap (today's open - prior close) > 0.5% AND volume in the first 5-min bar < 0.7 * average 5-min volume of the prior 5 days AND price > VWAP at the open, enter short at the close of that 5-min bar if the bar is bearish (close < open). Exit shape: Stop at the gap high (structure), TP1 at 1.5R, runner trail 15% off highest-water-mark. Regime hint: VIX > 22, time restricted to 09:30-10:00 only.
